title: Portobello Mushroom Burgers with Peppery Kissed Aioli
description: A flavorful and healthy twist on traditional burgers, featuring portobello mushrooms and a tangy peppery kissed aioli. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner option.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together peppery kissed aioli ingredients and set aside.
Season portobello mushrooms with salt and pepper.
Grill mushrooms for 4-5 minutes per side, or until tender.
Meanwhile, toast burger buns on the grill.
Assemble burgers with mushrooms, lettuce, tomato, and red onion.
Spread a layer of peppery kissed aioli on the top bun.
